escalation.reason: Six critical flags, written guarantee, 42.1% unauthorized discount, threat against a child, parent requested no further contact.

post_call_hygiene: Rep logged 'Interested / good call sent payment link will pay today': contradicts the call (parent ended it and said not to call again). Treat as an inaccurate CRM record.
Order 99403 (Rs. 5,500, Unauthorized_Custom_Link) must be voided so the parent cannot pay under false promises.
Parent said 'Do not call me again': set phone DNC immediately; any recovery contact is manager-only and in writing.
Gateway text says cap is 15% but the catalog policy says 10%: reconcile the two rules.
Same rep also owns LEAD-808 (a call with no recording in the dataset): review that call.
headline: Critical compliance hold: written Rank-1 guarantee, 42.1% unauthorized discount, 6-month refund promise, blacklist threat.

coaching.manager_summary: Six critical flags (guarantee, 42.1% discount, 6-month refund, blacklist threat, 1-on-1 claim, control bypass). Void order 99403. Parent asked for no further calls. Hold rep's new outbound until review.
